result.reason: The redline removes all early-termination charges, provides a pro-rata refund of prepaid Charges, and does not add any Vendor termination-for-convenience right. Although retaining the calendar-month-end requirement means the right is not exercisable on exactly 30 days’ notice, the resulting notice period is still within or more Customer-favorable than the fallback range. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve the scope and prerequisite-attachment exception. Drafting quality is reduced because subsection (b) does not grammatically follow the lead-in 'Customer may terminate ... by' and should instead be stated as a separate consequence of termination.
